display.name: Hub · Background workshop
display.description: Durable work by feature: queue health, acknowledged outcomes and useful failure traces. Snapshot freshness distinguishes empty from unavailable.

display.name: Queue snapshot age
display.description: Seconds since the worker last read queue state, including sample age. With 60s metric collection: amber after 120s, red after 180s.

spec.query: SELECT scalar_value + GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - recorded_timestamp))) AS seconds FROM metrics WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production' AND metric_name = 'bot.feature_jobs.snapshot_age' ORDER BY recorded_timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

display.name: Waiting, running and held
display.description: Latest count or age per feature/kind. Pending includes leased work; overdue excludes active leases. Old samples must not be read as current.

spec.query: WITH latest AS (SELECT recorded_timestamp, metric_name, attributes->>'feature' AS feature, attributes->>'job.kind' AS kind, scalar_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY metric_name, attributes->>'feature', attributes->>'job.kind' ORDER BY recorded_timestamp DESC) AS position FROM metrics WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production' AND metric_name IN ('bot.feature_jobs.pending','bot.feature_jobs.held','bot.feature_jobs.leased','bot.feature_jobs.overdue','bot.feature_jobs.oldest_due')) SELECT feature,kind,metric_name AS signal,scalar_value AS value,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now()-recorded_timestamp)) AS sample_age_seconds FROM latest WHERE position=1 ORDER BY feature,kind,signal

display.name: Acknowledged job outcomes
display.description: Unsampled state acknowledgments. Retry, hold and expiry are distinct; an unavailable acknowledgment cannot be counted as complete. Totals separate process/counter epochs and include initial values only for epochs starting within the selected window.

spec.query:
WITH streams AS (SELECT service_version, service_instance_id, process_pid,
        CASE WHEN aggregation_temporality = 'cumulative' THEN start_timestamp END AS counter_epoch,
        aggregation_temporality,attributes->>'feature' AS feature,attributes->>'job.kind' AS kind,attributes->>'state' AS state,metric_increase(value, recorded_timestamp)
            + CASE WHEN aggregation_temporality = 'cumulative'
                AND MIN(start_timestamp) >= CAST($__from_iso_string AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
                AND MIN(start_timestamp) <= CAST($__to_iso_string AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
                THEN COALESCE(MIN(scalar_value), 0) ELSE 0 END AS n FROM metrics WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production' AND metric_name='bot.feature_jobs.transitions' GROUP BY service_version, service_instance_id, process_pid, counter_epoch, aggregation_temporality,feature,kind,state) SELECT feature,kind,state,SUM(n) AS transitions FROM streams GROUP BY feature,kind,state HAVING SUM(n)>0 ORDER BY transitions DESC LIMIT 100

display.name: Recent job failures
display.description: Retained failure logs, with useful trace links and safe reason/location. Payloads, document keys and lease tokens are not exported.

spec.query: SELECT date_trunc('second',start_timestamp) AS time_utc,attributes->>'feature' AS feature,attributes->>'job.kind' AS kind,attributes->>'job.attempt' AS attempt,attributes->>'outcome' AS outcome,attributes->>'error.reason' AS reason,attributes->>'code.file.path' AS source,trace_id,span_id FROM records WHERE service_name = 'msu-hub-bot' AND deployment_environment = 'production' AND kind='log' AND span_name='bot.operation.failed' AND attributes->>'boundary'='job.run' ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 50
